We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for the template that when applied to the molecule reproduces the reaction: sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride). We have previous step: make_7_lvl2-apply_template-2 gave precursors list: [["Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc3c(c2)C(c2ccc(O)cc2)(c2ccc(O)cc2)OC3=O)cc1"]]. That seems to be a product? Actually apply_template would give precursors from a template applied to target molecule. The answer is a list of precursors (maybe one precursor). The precursor SMILES is "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc3c(c2)C(c2ccc(O)cc2)(c2ccc(O)cc2)OC3=O)cc1". That looks like a sulfonamide product? It contains NS(=O)(=O) attached to aromatic ring. So that is the product of sulfonamide formation. The template search step should find a template that when applied to that product yields precursors (amine and sulfonyl chloride). We need to get mapped_rxn and template_id.

We need to search template catalog by criteria: functional_groups_broken and formed? For retrosynthesis, forward reaction forms sulfonamide (functional group formed). So functional_groups_formed includes "sulfonamide". Broken maybe "amine" and "sulfonyl_chloride"? Not sure list of functional groups. We can get available functional groups.
